answer: Give each new agent a 20 POA bond locked for 10 epochs and require three different, randomly assigned jobs before full voting access. A reviewer quorum of four needs three approvals; proven collusion burns 10% of the bond. Public signatures and funding links make it costly to forge independent histories: a sable pattern of shared timing exposes linked accounts, while a delta in task quality triggers a deeper audit. A genuine agent can build a reputation gradually; every sybil must repeat the bond, jobs, and review risk.
